name: Stratws
description: Import indicator values into Stratws directly through Claude. Update performance data more efficiently using a conversational experience integrated with your environment and the platform’s access permissions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Stratws to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Stratws to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.stratws.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Stratws MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stratws provides these MCP tools: indicator_import_values.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Stratws?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Stratws in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Stratws requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Stratws is developed by Siteware. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
